metaTitle: Switch from Nightbot or StreamElements - ItsBagelBot
metaDesc: Import your Twitch bot setup in minutes. The wizard brings commands over from Nightbot, StreamElements, Moobot, Streamlabs Chatbot, Fossabot or WizeBot, with timers and quotes where your old bot has them, and you review every item before it is written.
title: Bring your setup with you.
lead: Commands come over from your current bot, with timers and quotes where it has them. You review every item before it lands.
step1Desc: Nightbot connects over OAuth. StreamElements takes your JWT token, Fossabot and WizeBot only need your channel name, and Moobot and Streamlabs Chatbot take an export file.
step2Desc: Every command, timer and quote is listed before it is written. Keep, skip, or adjust each one; nothing lands silently.
step3Desc: Approved items are written to your channel and the bot starts answering. Your old bot is untouched; retire it whenever you are ready.
src1Desc: Connects over OAuth. Brings commands and timers.
src2Desc: Paste the JWT token from your StreamElements dashboard. Brings commands, timers and keyword triggers.
src3Desc: Upload the export from Tools, then Import & Export. Brings commands and timers.
src4Desc: Upload your Chatbot.db file. Brings commands, timers and quotes.
src5Desc: Type your channel name. Your public commands page is read, so there is nothing to sign in to. Brings commands.
src6Desc: Type your channel name. Brings commands.
limitsNote: Nothing is written to your channel until you approve it.
faqA1: Commands from every source. Timers from Nightbot, StreamElements, Moobot and Streamlabs Chatbot, and quotes from Streamlabs Chatbot. The wizard lists everything it found and you decide item by item.
faqQ2: Do I have to remove my old bot first?
faqA2: No. The import never touches your old bot. Run both while you test and part ways when you are ready.
faqQ3: Will my command responses survive the move?
faqA3: The wizard translates what it can into ItsBagelBot's variable system and shows you the result before anything is written, so nothing lands silently broken.
faqA4: Yes. The import wizard, like everything else, is part of the free tier.
faqQ5: What should I check after importing?
faqA5: Turn off the matching commands in your old bot so chat doesn't get two answers. Check each timer's interval and whether it should post offline. Then try every command that used your old bot's variables, since those are the ones most likely to read differently.
ctaTitle: Two minutes and your setup is home.
